name: dt_ruletable
drl:
// rule values at A6, header at A1
rule "Discounts_6"
	salience 5
	no-loop true
	when
		Person(age > 30, tier == "gold")
	then
		insert(new Discount(10));
end

// rule values at A7, header at A1
rule "Discounts_7"
	when
		Person(tier == "silver")
	then
		insert(new Discount(5));
end

// rule values at A8, header at A1
rule "Discounts_8"
	salience (1 + 1)
	when
		Person(age > 60)
	then
		insert(new Discount(15));
end
_finding: D-391 decision tables: RuleTable with merged object cells, a blank cell, PRIORITY (literal and expression) and NO-LOOP columns. The DRL is seine_rs.decision_table(...).rules, byte-identical (modulo the package/import header) to Drools' SpreadsheetCompiler output.
